run_hf_download: run the hf download command to download models, datasets, or spaces from the Hugging Face Hub
run_hf_upload: run the hf upload command to upload files or folders to a Hugging Face Hub repository
run_hf_auth_login: run the hf auth login command to authenticate with the Hugging Face Hub using an API token
run_hf_models_list: run the hf models command to list, search, or inspect models on the Hugging Face Hub
run_hf_datasets_list: run the hf datasets command to list, search, or inspect datasets on the Hugging Face Hub
